content.askWelcome: Ask me anything about Scania connected services: Fleet Management, driver evaluation, environmental reports, maintenance plans and battery-electric trucks. Or ask about your own fleet data and I will chart it live.
content.askEmptySub: Ask any analytical question about your fleet: distance, fuel and energy, CO2, idling, driver scores, maintenance adherence and unplanned stops. Answers come straight from your live data with an interactive chart you can drill into.
